claim: Density witnesses and fixed-family P3 bound reproduce; all-density best-product ranking remains unresolved after REVIEW-A2.
source_report_body:
MAINLINE-061 complete; closes ord-admiral-rr2-mainline061-dispatch-1020. CARD, RESULTS, INPUTS, NFI, method, numerical records and manifest are pinned below.

PROJECTION: favorable P2 endpoint density factors at R12/20/30 are 1.1222/1.0766/1.0593 ISA and 1.1664/1.1183/1.1001 optimistic. The best feasible product puts all improvement into density; handbook R30 factors are 2.1435/2.2480. R30 requires least improvement. These are replacement-face targets retaining Be properties, not demonstrated lower-density Be.

P3 has no finite combination of the named strength/retention/film/node levers within the inherited constant-g/R family: local tube-shell compression binds, even after free film/joints/cavity and generous relief credit. All sizes include seven-day SIOX/3A service. Broader geometry optimization and gamma-to-047 physical tolerances remain explicit NFI.

NASA Table VI-1 corrects TRL7 hardware from 6% to 5%; battery remains separate. Large-R cure demand is shown alongside frozen CHECK-057 bills. R30 reference faces use 23.77–24.38% of estimated 2025 world mined Be. No finite historical closing-year forecast survives.

Fifteen author checks passed across 240 accounts; independent REVIEW-A remains pending under dispatch-pinned PROCESS-v2. Its later source drift was resolved by recovering original bytes with the declared hash. All scientific claims remain QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION. No further action requested; stopping.
